_source: Extracted from Forms OGSERC/REG-01A to REG-01K (version 2026.1) and the Registration Form Selection Guide. Fees and late charges on every form match seed-data.json schedule3_fees.
filing_type_note: Updates and annual confirmations quote the existing OGSERC registration number. Annual confirmation is due by 31 January each year.

A Applicant: registrant type (Company, Cooperative, Partnership, Sole proprietor, Public body, Community organization, Other)
B Ownership and management: shareholders/members ≥5%: name, nationality/country, % holding, beneficial owner Y/N (multiple)
directors and key officers: name, position, phone, email (multiple)
managing director / principal officer: name, phone, email
regulatory compliance officer: name, phone, email

status_checkboxes: NERC licence — activity wholly in Ogun State
NERC mini-grid / captive registration or permit

D Service area: towns, communities, estates or industrial clusters served

Other activities.rule: Tick every other activity; fee is for the highest category (para 17(1)); attach the activity section(s) of the matching form

Health, safety and environment: incidents in last 24 months: date, location, type (incident / fatality / outage > 24 h), description and action (multiple)
Confidentiality claim: item claimed as commercially sensitive, reasons (multiple)
Registration fee: category, fee and late charge printed on the form
payment reference / receipt no. and date
Declaration: two signatories (name, designation, signature, date, seal): director + company secretary; else two directors/principal officers; sole proprietor alone; public body by accounting officer

document_conditions.holds_any_licence: Licence status is anything other than 'No licence, permit or registration'
document_conditions.multi_state_licensee: Form A applicant is a multi-State licensee (Section E/I)
document_conditions.generation_for_sale: Generation activity includes any 'for sale' option (not captive only)
document_conditions.grid_connected: Plant is connected to TCN, a DisCo or a private network
document_conditions.f_trading: Form F Part 2 (trading and bulk supply) applies
document_conditions.g_disco_bulk_supply: Network's source of supply is DisCo bulk supply (inferred; the form doesn't mark it conditional — confirm)

measurement_units_note: Forms A, B, C, D, F, J report energy in MWh; E, G, K report kWh; I reports kW and MWh. Normalise on storage.

forms.title: Own-use generation notification (200 kW to below 1 MW)
notes: ONE NOTIFICATION PER SITE (not per registrant)
Short form: no ownership, licence, service-area, other-activities, HSE or confidentiality sections
Late-registration charges do not apply (form cites para 19(1)); file within 60 days of the Effective Date
Sites of 1 MW+ register on REG-01D/C; below 200 kW need not file; any third-party supply means the activity's own form
Official-use box includes 'OGSERC Registration No.' and 'Certificate issue date'
sections: A Identity (name, CAC, site address, contact person, phone, email)
B Site and use (nature of premises/business, LGA, connected to a distribution licensee? which)
